`json.lua` is rxi/json version 0.1.2, distributed under its embedded MIT license.
Upstream: https://github.com/rxi/json.lua

This encoder is also used by Steamodded/BalatroBot. Tests run the real Lua
gamestate exporter and encoder through LuaJIT 2.1 to catch serialization errors
that Python fixtures cannot reproduce. No Balatro game files are included.
